faqs.q: Is a root canal completed in a single sitting without pain?
faqs.a: Yes. Over 90% of routine cases finish in one 45–60 minute sitting. Electronic apex locators and slow-infusion local anaesthesia keep the whole treatment painless.
Yes. We keep same-day slots for throbbing toothache, abscess, broken crowns and dental trauma. Call or message us by morning and we will fit you in that day.

faqs.q: Why a specialist clinic instead of a general dentist?
faqs.a: Complex work — implants, root canals, veneers — is done by MDS postgraduate specialists in each discipline, not general dentists. You get hospital-level specialist care.
Usually 3–4 months and 2–3 visits. We confirm the timeline and a written cost before anything starts.

faqs.q: Are zirconia crowns as strong as metal?
faqs.a: Yes. Monolithic zirconia is strong, has no dark line, and matches the translucency of natural teeth — the best of both worlds.
You feel mild pressure for a few days after each tray change. Most patients adjust within a week and never need pain relief.

faqs.q: What is included in the price?
faqs.a: The listed price covers the procedure, materials and follow-up. Digital X-rays are included with treatment — no hidden sterilisation charges.
Yes. Gentle paediatric check-ups and early care from age 7. We keep visits short and friendly.

costFaqs.q: Why do prices vary by case?
costFaqs.a: Your exact cost depends on the tooth, the number of canals or implants, and the materials we choose together. The range covers the common cases.
Digital X-rays are included with treatment. CBCT scans are quoted separately when a case needs them.
Yes. 0% EMI in 3, 6 and 9 months on treatments above ₹10,000 with a simple approval process.

costFaqs.q: What is the same-day emergency price for?
costFaqs.a: Priority appointment within hours plus the relief procedure — drainage, temporary filling or pain relief. No waiting, no extra call-out charges.

costFaqs.q: Can I get a written estimate?
costFaqs.a: Yes. You get a line-by-line written estimate before treatment starts. No surprises, ever.
